web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's PMI data for July indicated a slowdown in economic momentum. The official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.2 from 50.3 in June, entering contraction territory. The non-manufacturing PMI (services and construction) also dropped to 49.0 from 50.2, indicating contraction in both sectors. The composite PMI declined below 50, reflecting weakening economic activity.
